paraphrase: The practitioner of these mantras must be devoted to the Jina and to his teacher, truthful, self-controlled, free of anger and deceit, courageous and discreet; the mantras given without these qualities do not bear fruit.
notes: Restricted text: only the qualifications and the text's framing are recorded, no mantras or rites. Chapter 1 (sādhaka-lakṣaṇa) recalled in outline.
